v192 · Goethe A1 Mock Exam: four-skill alignment and score integrity

Completed a focused audit of the existing Finalprüfung. Fixed the first five Lesen items, which had been rendered as four-option multiple choice despite being Richtig/Falsch tasks; the Teil-2 items are now labelled and presented as paired classified advertisements, and all three reading parts have explicit task-type metadata. The Sprechen Teil 2 simulation now uses two separate everyday word-card topics, matching the two-topic information exchange; its prompt/model playback covers both. Writing cannot be marked complete with an empty draft, both core writing tasks are required for the writing completion flag, and each speaking part requires all three self-rating criteria to be recorded before completion. Added a four-skill practice-score dashboard with 25 points per skill, using objective raw results for Hören/Lesen and explicitly self-assessed estimates for Schreiben/Sprechen. The 60-point reference threshold is displayed only as a practice comparison, not an official result. The recommended written-exam order and no-break condition are documented; section timers remain individually started rather than a single continuous timer.

Validation: 15 Lesen and 15 Hören items; all answer indices and option counts; Lesen Teil 1/2/3 types; Hören replay limits and transcripts; two-topic Speaking state and handlers; non-empty Writing completion guard; explicit Writing/Speaking rubric completion; 25-point estimate arithmetic; official 60-point comparison labelling; JavaScript syntax. Original TTS audio, self-assessment limits and non-official task status remain disclosed. No live iPhone Safari test is claimed.
